honesty.title: Simulated connections (L0).
honesty.body: No analyzer has been connected yet. Everything here runs through Natija's simulators and stays simulated until it has been bench-tested on the real instrument (L2) and validated by the lab (L3).

hint.V: Protocol details taken from the manufacturer's manual.
hint.L: Protocol details from secondary sources; confirm with the vendor's host-interface manual.
hint.U: No public specification. The demo uses an invented format.

hint.tcp_server: The Lab Agent listens; the analyzer (or a serial device server) connects to it.
hint.tcp_client: The Lab Agent connects to the analyzer (or to a serial device server).
hint.serial: A COM port on the Lab Agent's PC.

board.title: Analyzers
board.description: Connection status, today's traffic and what needs review, for every analyzer in the lab.
board.emptyHint: Analyzers are set up by the lab administrator.

overview.research: What we know about this interface
overview.researchHint: From the protocol research; check it against the vendor's manual before going live.
overview.bidirectional: Asks the host for its work
overview.levelPolicy: Raise the readiness level only with evidence: L1 after building from the vendor's manual, L2 after a bench test on the real analyzer, L3 after the lab's validation.
overview.invented: Boditech publishes no host-interface specification for the ichroma III. This analyzer uses a format we made up only so the demo covers it. It is not Boditech's protocol.
overview.name: Name
overview.hostHintClient: Address of the analyzer or serial device server.
overview.hostHintServer: Address the Lab Agent listens on (empty: the agent's default).
overview.levelWarnTitle: Raise the readiness level only with evidence

levelWarn.L1: L1 means the interface was built from this analyzer's own host-interface manual. Keep the manual reference in the notes.
levelWarn.L2: L2 means it was tested on the real analyzer, with every message type and fault, outside patient work.
levelWarn.L3: L3 means the lab validated it and uses it for patient results. Record the validation in the notes.

hint.duplicate: The same message is sent twice; it must be applied once.
hint.bad_checksum: ASTM: every try of frame 2 fails its checksum and is refused. HL7 has no checksum: a message with broken delimiters is sent and refused.
hint.unknown_code: One extra test code that is not in the code map: it must go to review.
hint.unknown_sample: A barcode that does not exist: every value must go to review.

sim.title: Simulate this analyzer
sim.description: Builds realistic messages for this model and sends them through the real link layer, exactly the path Lab Agent traffic takes. Everything is marked simulated.
sim.barcodesHint: Optional, up to 5. Empty: tubes waiting for this analyzer are picked.
sim.qcHint: QC results use the analyzer's QC materials.
sim.noPermission: Running a simulation needs analyzer management or result entry rights.
sim.refusedBody: The host refused this transmission at the link layer, so nothing reached the results.
sim.duplicateBody: Same content as an earlier message: recognised as a duplicate and not applied again.
sim.errorTitle: Stored as an error, not applied

notes.checksumAstm_one: The host answered NAK {{count}} time; the analyzer gave up (EOT). Nothing was applied, and the partial message is stored as an error.
notes.checksumAstm_other: The host answered NAK {{count}} times; the analyzer gave up (EOT). Nothing was applied, and the partial message is stored as an error.
notes.checksumHl7: HL7 over MLLP has no checksum: the host could not read the corrupted message, answered AR (reject) and stored it as an error.
notes.duplicate: The repeated message had the same content: it was recognised as a duplicate and not applied twice.
notes.applied_one: {{count}} value was written to its result, with flags, reference ranges and critical alerts.
notes.applied_other: {{count}} values were written to their results, with flags, reference ranges and critical alerts.
notes.review_one: {{count}} value could not be applied safely and waits in the review queue.
notes.review_other: {{count}} values could not be applied safely and wait in the review queue.
notes.ichroma: ichroma III traffic uses an invented demo format; Boditech publishes no specification.
notes.medica: The Medica printout layout is an assumption until checked against a real printout.
notes.simulated: Simulated traffic (L0): no real analyzer took part.

steps.sentHint: Tubes and tests in this run.

wireHint.astm: ASTM E1381: ENQ/ACK, numbered frames with checksums, NAK on errors, EOT to finish.
wireHint.hl7: HL7 v2 over MLLP: each message framed ⟨VT⟩…⟨FS⟩⟨CR⟩ and answered with an acknowledgement.
wireHint.medica_text: Plain printout text: no framing, no acknowledgement.
wireHint.ichroma_invented: Invented demo lines: no framing, no acknowledgement.

steps.parsedHint: Every record or segment with its fields, as Natija read it.
steps.unreadable: This message could not be parsed.
steps.outcomeHint: Instrument code → lab analyte, the value as written, and what happened to each result.

reasonHints.unknown_sample: No tube in Natija has this barcode. Check the barcode on the analyzer, then assign the value to the right result or dismiss it.
reasonHints.unknown_code: This instrument code is not in the analyzer's code map. Assign it to the right result; you can also remember the mapping for next time.
reasonHints.unit_mismatch: The analyzer sent a different unit from the one in the code map, so the value was not converted silently. Check the analyzer's settings and the map.
reasonHints.no_order_item: The tube was found, but this test is not ordered on it. Assign it if it belongs to another line, or dismiss it.
reasonHints.sample_rejected: The tube was rejected, so its results are not applied.
reasonHints.result_locked: The result was already validated. The new value is kept as an attempt; amend the result from the results screen if needed.

messages.emptyHint: Messages appear here as soon as the analyzer or the simulator sends them.

errors.incomplete: Incomplete: the link dropped before the message ended

mappings.description: Which lab analyte each instrument code feeds, and the factor that converts the analyzer's unit to the lab's unit. A different unit from the one mapped sends the value to review.
mappings.restoreHint: Adds the model's default codes for analytes this lab has. Existing mappings are kept.
mappings.deleteHint: Values with this code will go to review until it is mapped again.
mappings.emptyHint: Restore the defaults or add mappings one by one.
mappings.codeHint: Exactly as the analyzer sends it (case matters on some analyzers).
mappings.unitHint: The unit the analyzer sends; leave empty to skip the unit check.

maintenance.description: Daily, weekly and monthly maintenance, repairs and calibrations.
maintenance.dueHint: Overdue or due in the next two weeks, from the latest entry per analyzer and kind.
maintenance.noneDue: Nothing due in the next two weeks
maintenance.nextDueHint: When it should be done next.
maintenance.descriptionPlaceholder: What was done, parts changed, findings…

agents.title: Lab Agents
agents.description: The small service on a lab PC that talks to the analyzers and sends results to Natija. It connects outward only and keeps everything on disk while the internet is down.
agents.addHint: You get a one-time code to enrol the agent on the lab PC.
agents.nameHint: Where it runs, e.g. the bench PC near the chemistry analyzer.
agents.emptyHint: Add one for each PC that connects analyzers.
agents.virtualHint: Built into the platform; carries simulated traffic only.
agents.codeExpired: Code expired: issue a new one
agents.revokeHint: Its token stops working at once and its analyzers go offline. Messages still on the lab PC stay there until a new agent is enrolled.
agents.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the text instead
agents.commandHint: From the Natija folder on that PC. The agent saves its token in its config file.
agents.once: Natija keeps only a protected hash of this code. Close this window and the code cannot be shown again; issue a new one if needed.
agents.step1: Install Node.js 24 and the Natija agent on the lab PC.
agents.step2: Run the command above; the agent then appears here as active.
agents.step3: Set the analyzers in the agent's config and run it as a Windows service.
agents.links: Analyzer links reported by the agent

review.title: Review queue
review.description: Analyzer values Natija could not apply safely by itself. Nothing is dropped silently: assign each value to the right result or dismiss it with a reason.
review.emptyOpenHint: Unknown tubes, unknown codes and other held values appear here.
review.dismissHint: It will not be applied. The reason is kept in the audit trail.
review.noCandidatesHint: No tube with this barcode and no pending result for this analyte in the last week.
review.valueOverrideHint: Empty: the received value ({{value}}), converted with the code map.
review.remember: Also map code {{code}} to this analyte

qc.title: Quality control
qc.description: Control materials, Levey-Jennings charts and Westgard rules. A rejected run alerts the analyzer managers.
qc.instrumentHint: Leave as any analyzer to share the material.
qc.emptyMaterialsHint: Add the controls you run, with their lot, level and target values.
qc.pickMaterial: Pick a material to see its chart
qc.noRunsHint: Enter a run, or simulate QC results from an analyzer's page.
qc.acceptedBody: Within the control limits: patient results can be reported.
qc.rejectedAction: Do not report patient results from this run. Look for the cause, correct it and run the control again.

rules.2-2s: two values in a row beyond 2 SD on the same side
rules.R-4s: two values in a row, one above +2 SD and the other below −2 SD
rules.4-1s: four values in a row beyond 1 SD on the same side
rules.10x: ten values in a row on the same side of the mean

errors.no_pending_samples: No tubes are waiting for this analyzer. Create an order with tests mapped to it and collect the tube, or enter barcodes.
errors.fault_not_applicable: This fault does not apply to this protocol: it has no checksum or acknowledgement.
errors.simulation_unsupported: There is no simulator for this analyzer model.
errors.protocol_mismatch: The simulator for this model speaks a different protocol from the one set on the analyzer.
errors.no_mappings: This analyzer has no code mappings yet.
errors.no_qc_materials: No active QC material is set up for the analytes this analyzer reports.
errors.specimen_id_too_long: A barcode is longer than this analyzer accepts.
errors.agent_revoked: This Lab Agent was revoked; create a new one.
errors.no_default_menu: This model has no default test menu.
errors.virtual_agent: The virtual agent runs inside Natija and cannot be changed.
errors.result_locked: The result is already validated; amend it from the results screen.
errors.no_value: There is no value to write; enter one.
errors.no_instrument_code: The item has no instrument code to map.
errors.qc_material_has_runs: This material has runs; deactivate it instead of deleting it.
